ANOMALY LOCALIZATION

Evaluation protocol

  1. Training split.One-class protocol: normal-only training data, separate from this held-out test sample.
  2. Prediction format.Pixel-level anomaly scores; thresholded regions where required by the evaluation protocol.
  3. Reference comparison.Binary ground truth for localization metrics and false-positive / false-negative analysis.

VisA · Zou et al., ECCV 2022 · CC BY 4.0. This viewer displays the source image and supplied reference annotation. The detection workflow above explains their use; the overlay is the dataset label.

Inspect the annotation, measurements and evaluation method

MEASURED FROM THIS MASK

Image and mask alignment1404 × 1070 pixels
Annotated pixelsLoading…
Share of the full imageLoading…
Region bounds [x₀, y₀, x₁, y₁)Loading…

The mask contains 0 for background and 255 for annotated anomaly. Coverage describes annotation size, not severity or confidence. Bounds use a top-left origin and exclude the final x₁/y₁ edges.

WHAT AN EVALUATOR COMPARES

Intersection over union (IoU) compares the overlap of predicted and reference regions with the area marked by either. Missed reference pixels are false negatives; extra predicted pixels are false positives.

For continuous anomaly scores, threshold-independent measures such as pixel-level AUROC assess ranking across thresholds. Metric choice and operating threshold should match the inspection task. This sample has a reference mask; no prediction is supplied to calculate a detection score.

Download measured region ↓

The VisA paper describes manually generated realistic anomalies and provides image- and pixel-level annotations. It does not identify the precise marking tool or annotator for this mask. The “bent pin” description is a visual interpretation; this binary mirror retains no multiclass defect ID. See the original paper, section 4.1.

Image and mask were extracted unchanged from the pinned BrachioLab mirror. The crop, outline and amber color are display transformations; the original files remain downloadable.
